coverage_override.reason: The Normal/Special Summon search trigger and the battle-start send/ATK trigger are two effects; each HOPT sentence belongs to its effect.

effects.printed_clause: If Normal or Special Summoned: add Bear Trap or a Mine Field Spell from the Deck. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Normal and Special Summon trigger clones share an id-keyed limit. The filter accepts Bear Trap or any Field Spell whose exact code is in the generated standalone-Mine name pool; the pool is rebuilt from the official Omega database and local card source and currently includes Mystic Mine and Recollection: the Mine.

official_references.matched_structure: Combines an exact listed card with a printed-name/listed relationship in a Deck search filter.
Provides the official Omega identity and Field Spell type for an official card whose name contains the standalone word Mine.

effects.issue: Fixed: the search now includes official Mystic Mine and is generated from all current Mine-named Field Spells instead of hard-coding only the local Mine card.

effects.printed_clause: If your Vir Pedicae Mortis monster battles: send a qualifying Recollection Spell from Deck to GY; that monster gains 500 ATK. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: An EVENT_BATTLE_START field trigger identifies the controlled face-up archetype battler, sends an eligible Recollection Spell as cost, and applies a persistent 500 ATK update to that same related battler under a distinct hard count key.
